name: Islands Void
design_intent:
FLAGSHIP islands-over-a-void arena (owner directive 2026-07-04 arena_variety). Kill identity = knock rivals OFF / BETWEEN separated islands into the bottom blast void -> off the screen. Four separated island platforms at the play tier (A trampoline x0..640 top1080 / B bubblegum x1320..1840 top940 / C trampoline x2520..3120 top1120 / D bubblegum x3800..4320 top980) float over ONE full-width lethal void (rim y=1260, the whole bottom band is a dark chasm). Two elevated spring throne-pads (F x780..1100 top560 / E x1900..2260 top420) sit ABOVE spring apex, boost-only. Side runways (-560 / +560, bounds -560..4880) keep the side edges as blast lines too, but the DOMINANT kill shape is the bottom void: any fall off an island edge, or any failed gap-crossing, drops through open sky into the chasm and off the bottom bound (y>1920) = off-screen kill. This fixes grassy_expanse's central-pit plurality/dead-air problem by making the void the arena floor, not a single mid-map hole.

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270px, spring apex 480px, air_drift_max 340px/s, gravity 1600 => zero-boost horizontal reach ~400px off a trampoline / ~527px off a spring; normal_boost_max 760px/s crosses a gap in <1s @ ~26 fuel, bounce refunds +20; super_boost_impulse 2800 clears everything):
- GAP A->B: island edges x640..x1320 = 680px horizontal over open void. > 527 (max spring drift) and >> 400 (trampoline drift, and no spring here). NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall into the void. Verb: FLY.
- GAP B->C: x1840..x2520 = 680px over the void (the deepest central chasm; spring throne E hangs over it). > 527. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- GAP C->D: x3120..x3800 = 680px over the void. > 527. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- CLIMB to spring pad F (top560): 520px above island A's top (1080). Trampoline apex from A only reaches y=810 (270 rise) -> still 250px short; A refuels but cannot bounce onto F. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- CLIMB to spring throne E (top420): 520px above island B's top (940). Bubblegum apex (180) reaches y=760 -> 340px short. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED, and E hangs over the B->C void gap so an under-shot climb drops you into the chasm. Verb: FLY (+ SUPER earns the throne fast).
- Every play-tier gap (680px) exceeds even a spring bounce's reach, and every elevated pad sits >480px above the nearest surface, so NO route across or up the arena exists without the jetpack. Bouncing alone strands you on your island (and idle_hunt punishes camping); traversal, contesting powerups, and reaching the throne all REQUIRE boost, and the biggest cross-map plays reward super. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing here, not scenery.

RECOVERY GAMBLE: the fall from an island bottom (~1050-1248) to the bottom blast line (1920) is ~670-870px of open sky over the chasm -> a knocked-off player who still has fuel can boost back to an island (the recovery gamble), while a near-edge dead-on super spikes them straight past the rim. Side runways (560px outside the outer island edges) preserve the same near-edge-out / mid-stage-arcs-back gradient on the left/right blast lines. VOID READS AS DEATH via the pit_void_rendering treatment (dark cool bottomless gradient + receding dirt canyon walls at the arena sides + under-lip AO + matte hazard-red rim/chevrons along y=1260 + falling motes) so the whole bottom is unmistakably lethal, not safe green.
